page_title: HAM 0-2 PAU | Hamburger SV v St. Pauli 29/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+8' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
90+4' The attendance is 57000.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.
88' St. Pauli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
87' Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off a great save to deny Danel Sinani (St. Pauli), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
82' Here is a change. Mathias Pereira Lage is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Dzwigala trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli).
82' Substitution. William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) in, Ransford Konigsdorffer out.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
77' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
75' Here comes a substitution. Nicolas Capaldo is given a rest as he is replaced by Otto Stange (Hamburger).
75' Merlin Polzin prepares a substitution. Daniel Elfadli is replaced by Rayan Philippe (Hamburger).
74' The resulting corner from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is cleared.
72' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) is coming onto the pitch as Andreas Hountondji cannot continue after picking up an injury.

68' What a save from Nikola Vasilj! Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
64' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) for his blatant foul.
60' 0 - 2 Joel Fujita passes to Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) coming on for Arkadiusz Pyrka.
57' A rebound falls kindly for Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
56' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) replaces Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit.
56' A substitution has been made. Emir Sahiti goes off and Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) comes on.
55' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
54' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
53' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) fires the resulting free kick to the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but Nikola Vasilj pulls off a superb save to deny him.
51' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Hamburger SV earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
50' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Hamburger SV players look gutted.
49' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Hamburger SV players aren’t happy.

48' Goal! Giorgi Gocholeishvili slips a clever pass through to Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
41' Good chance! Miro Muheim (Hamburger) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
37' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
35' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
32' Emir Sahiti (Hamburger) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
28' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
26' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) is booked for saying more than Christian Dingert was willing to tolerate.
19' 0 - 1 Goal! Mathias Pereira Lage tees up Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the top right corner. 0:1.
19' A quickly taken corner by St. Pauli.

19' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee blows his whistle, St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
17' A pass by Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
15' Christian Dingert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Eric Smith (St. Pauli).
14' The resulting set piece from Hamburger SV is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Hamburger SV force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
7' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
7' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
5' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) commits a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. St. Pauli will have the kick-off.
Christian Dingert will supervise the game today.
